item.title: 48 Hours In Seoul: Things To Do - The City Lane
item.description: If you only have a few days in Seoul, this list of things to do in Seoul is for you. There's a diverse range of things to see in Seoul.

item.title: Raas Indian, Brunswick - The City Lane
item.description: Raas Indian Brunswick showcases the diversity of Indian cuisine, mostly sticking to tradition, with a few playful twists along the way.

item.title: Lieu Privé, Hawthorn East - The City Lane
item.description: Lieu Privé is a cocktail bar in Hawthorn East featuring five distinct rooms. Visit for creative, playful cocktails, and a unique vibe.

item.title: Flying Scoot Economy Class From Melbourne To Singapore - The City Lane
item.description: Scoot Airlines fly 1-2 times a day from Melbourne to Singapore. Here's what you can expect when you book a ticket on the flight.

item.title: Mondo Gelateria, Melbourne CBD - The City Lane
item.description: Mondo Gelatera is a gelato spot in Melbourne, known for its premium quality ingredients, and globally-inspired flavours.

item.title: ChickyBoi, Fitzroy - The City Lane
item.description: ChickyBoi Melbourne specialises in fried chicken sandwiches, with what many consider to be the best friend chicken sandwiches in Melbourne.

item.title: Bistro X, Fitzroy - The City Lane
item.description: StandardX Melbourne is a fun and trendy hotel in the exciting Fitzroy neighbourhood. It's well located and a great base to explore.

item.title: Garfield Pizzeria, Carlton - The City Lane
item.description: Garfield Pizzeria is a new pizza spot on Lygon Street, Carlton. Visit for traditional woodfired pizzas, and experimental toppings.

item.title: Patris, Brunswick - The City Lane
item.description: Patris is a family-run Greek/Eastern European restaurant in Brunswick. Visit for tasty food, based in home cooking and recipes.
